'''2011 US Nationals Ryan Jellison LS Hidden Base (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Jellison]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base (V) / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V)|VB4-L-hiddenbase-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' The Scott Lingrell Deck
* '''Username:''' Sac 69837
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
